_comment: Narration for toeic-079 (P4: multi-word vocabulary). Source: js/data/packs/toeic.js, author beatrice. Teach phrases: 'a game of cat and mouse' and 'be consumed with' (story form 'was consumed with'). HANDOFF RULE: the note is inserted at the nearest natural punctuation boundary at or after the vocabulary's last word (comma, period, ; : ! ?), not right after the word. consumedSent declares `after: "with"` and the tool resolves the boundary ('queen,'): consumedLead + consumedRest, one TTS take. gameSent has no punctuation between 'mouse' and the end of the sentence, so the note goes after the whole sentence: a plain segment, no parts (an `after` there would be an error). The highlighted vocabulary (episode) and the pause (here) are separate things. Meanings: the segment text is what Ling SPEAKS (a natural reading); the card shows the source zh from the episode: 貓捉老鼠遊戲 / 被…吞噬；為…所苦. Examples are the real pack examples. The 'hook' segment is Hook H3 (scene_contrast); its payoff is revealed on 'forgot'. The story's last line 'She, meanwhile, was napping.' is kept for the end. Emoji are display-only.

segments.text: I was busy spying on their queen. I forgot to check my own honey sales.
Business update: a rival hive keeps following my scouts to my best flower field.
I move the scouts, they follow, and I move again.
It has become a game of cat and mouse that wastes time for both of us.
In the yard, the children played a game of cat and mouse, with one pretending to be the cat and the other the mouse.
Worse, I was consumed with spying on their queen, so I forgot to check my own honey sales.
被某件事吞噬、為某件事所苦。
She was consumed with guilt after the accident.
